Help describes -dups as exact MD5 duplicates. Previously inspected scanner normalizes JPEG digest input to scan payload and excludes headers/tables, so this label does not establish full-byte identity.
Help explicitly states -no-delete allows rename/move; matches reviewed GUI action boundaries. Move/rename preservation statements are not failure-atomicity tests.
Help lists -simtest, but fully reviewed main.cpp has no corresponding command branch. Static documentation/implementation mismatch; no executable launched.
Help describes -test-csv as CSV pairs; reviewed testCsv uses simple semicolon splitting and logs results without minimum accuracy acceptance gate. Documentation is not a passing matching test.
